human_hints.title: Vocal over a light beat, no bass
human_hints.summary: The vocal opens over pads and light percussion. No bass.

human_hints.title: Drums out, snare and hat build
human_hints.summary: The drum stem drops out. Snares and hats accelerate into the bass drop.

human_hints.title: Bass drop under the vocal
human_hints.summary: The sub and bass hit under the vocal. The drums stay light.

human_hints.title: Instrumental break, pads only
human_hints.summary: The vocal ends and the bass and drums fall away, leaving pads.

human_hints.title: Main instrumental drop
human_hints.summary: Kick, bass and sub all slam in together. No vocal.

human_hints.title: Mini break with vocal chop
human_hints.summary: The bass drops out for a few bars. A vocal-stem swell with no sung phrase detected.

human_hints.title: Drop continues
human_hints.summary: The full kick/bass groove returns, with a brief drum-stem gap near 89 s.

human_hints.title: Verse, vocal without bass or kick
human_hints.summary: Vocal over pads with a snare/hat pattern. The kick and bass are out.

human_hints.title: Chorus, bass under vocal, still no kick
human_hints.summary: The bass line returns under the chorus vocal. The kick stays out.

human_hints.title: Breakdown, snare-roll build
human_hints.summary: Bass out. The snare roll builds into the final drop.

human_hints.title: Final drop
human_hints.summary: Kick and bass back at full level.

human_hints.title: Short break
human_hints.summary: The bass drops out and the drums thin.

human_hints.title: Last drop run
human_hints.summary: The full groove for a final run.

human_hints.title: Outro, closing kick hit
human_hints.summary: The bass fades and the drums thin, then a final kick burst ends the song.
